item.title: Interpretable distance-resolved graph learning for cancer gene priority screening
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 16 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01327-4

Wang et al. propose CGMap, a distance-resolved graph-learning framework that maps dispersed oncogenic signals into structured priorities, narrowing the cancer gene candidate space and establishing an interpretable path from hypotheses to practical validation.
